hints.title: Three Orthogonal Views Decomposition
hints.text: The total projection area is the sum of footprints visible from above, from the front, and from the side.

hints.title: Axis-Aligned Projection Formulas
hints.text: Top shadow counts non-zero grid entries. Front shadow sums maximum heights per column. Side shadow sums maximum heights per row.

hints.title: Single Pass Accumulation
hints.text: Iterate over row and column boundaries, finding row maximums, column maximums, and incrementing top area whenever a grid cell is strictly positive.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def projectionArea(self, grid: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        n = len(grid)
        xy = sum(grid[r][c] > 0 for r in range(n) for c in range(n))
        yz = sum(max(grid[r][c] for r in range(n)) for c in range(n))
        zx = sum(max(grid[r]) for r in range(n))
        return xy + yz + zx
```
